title: Meeting Notes
description: Every meeting's notes, decisions and action items, with agendas ready to copy.

text.text: Every meeting gets a row: open it to write the notes. Promises go in Action items with an owner and a day.
Copy the agenda for your meeting kind into the meeting's page, then fill it in as you go.
Each person, two minutes, in the same order every time.
What I finished since last time
Their agenda first; yours only if time is left.
What is getting in the way
One thing to try before next time
Bring the numbers; leave with owners.
Three goals for the next period
What we are saying no to
Everyone writes first, then the room discusses.
Open with the decision you need; close with the next date.
Decisions we need from the client
Send the recap the same day

Every action item from every meeting lands here. Work this list on a schedule: scan Overdue first, then Due this week, and mark things done as they close so the next meeting starts from a clean slate.
An action item without an owner and a date is a wish. Fill in both before the meeting ends.
Short rules the studio keeps so meetings stay useful.
No agenda, no meeting: the agenda goes in the meeting's page a day ahead.
Start on time, end five minutes early.
Every decision is written in What was decided before the call ends.
Every promise becomes an action item with one owner and a due day.
Notes go out the same day; set the status to Notes sent.
If it is not written down, it was not decided.
